title: A coupled-oscillator model for the formation of planetary rings
summary: We study the dichotomy between compact satellite and ring formation in proto-planetary disks. Specifically, we examine the behavior of a model system of $N$ identical particles locked into circular, gravitationally-bound orbits around a central body. We treat interactions as dominated by inter-particle collisions, and extract an effective two-particle interaction function based on both theory and simulations.
